x: We are badly in need of a few first class sprinters for our senior matches as Lionel Grimshaw had muscle trouble and Gordon Lowers was not always available.
Stan Davies surprised most people, including himself, by winning the 440 yards, while Lionel Grimshaw was second in the 220 yards and we also had first and third in the 100.

Basil Walden was second in the 100 yards and Lionel Grimshaw won the 220. Jim Heathfield was third in the 440, John Cope won the 880 in 2 mins. 1.6 secs., while Bill Lucas won the mile in 4 mins. 30.2 secs.
